title: The Fall of the House of Usher
description: Summoned by a desperate letter, you come to Roderick Usher. A house by a dark tarn, a fissure down its front, his sister Madeline like a shadow. Something is ending here — and you will be beside him when it does.
line: An old friend calls you to a house that seems to share its masters' sickness.
source: after the tale by Edgar Allan Poe
